builder_plan.baseline: The existing kernel inside the same complete serving pipeline.
steps: Locate the paper's implementation and check its license, model support, data needs, and hardware requirements. Stop here if you cannot obtain the required artifacts.
Save a small set of representative product tasks and expected outcomes. Keep evaluation tasks out of any training or tuning, and choose quality and cost limits before running.
Run the baseline and the proposed change on identical inputs. Keep other settings fixed and repeat paired runs to expose variation.
Save per-task outputs, failures, timings, and all usage costs. Review regressions before expanding the test.
builder_plan.measure: Numerical differences, end-to-end latency, throughput, and memory at realistic shapes.
builder_plan.decision: Keep the change only if it meets your preselected quality and latency limits and improves the metric you care about after setup and operating costs. Otherwise retain the baseline. This is an exploration plan, not a validated recommendation.

title: ZYFA: Speed and Accuracy of FP8 FlashAttention on AMD CDNA4
summary: ZYFA replaces the vendor AITER FP8 attention kernels on AMD MI355X with a custom prefill kernel that approximates the softmax exponential with a multiply-add plus integer conversion, uses a ping-pong schedule to overlap softmax with matrix multiplies, and rescales probability blocks by powers of two before rounding. It costs adoption of a research-grade kernel tied to a single GPU architecture (CDNA4/MI355X), with added implementation complexity and dependence on instruction ordering rather than hardware synchronization. It can fail through throughput variability because the MI355X sustained clock depends on operand values, so benchmark gains on random inputs may not transfer to production activations, and it offers no benefit on NVIDIA hardware.
rationale: The gains are real but exclusive to the AMD MI355X, which the reader's 24 GB GPU or API-based infrastructure does not have, making this relevant only to track for future AMD hardware adoption.
